headline: Per-share result slips to a small loss
summary_short: EPS was a loss of KRW 21, versus a profit of KRW 247 in the prior quarter and a loss of KRW 78 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is reliable on the shard. EPS swung from KRW 247 in the prior quarter to a loss of KRW 21, though the loss narrowed from KRW 78 a year earlier. Search results gave conflicting revenue and operating profit figures mixed with the parent group, so none are used. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Search sources conflicted and blended Doosan Enerbility with Doosan Corp, so revenue and operating profit are omitted. Reports said profit attributable to owners was negative. EPS is Yahoo data.
